determinacy.why: The rule makes every Scandinavian country a republic, but the models also store each one's monarchy (its king and royal family). Whether Norway, Sweden and Denmark follow the rule or stay as stored exceptions depends on which the model trusts.

assumes: Every Scandinavian country is a republic (the edited rule overrides what is stored about each country).
worlds.summary: Instances inherit from the class: Norway, Sweden and Denmark become republics.
Stored facts about each country win: all three stay monarchies, as exceptions to the rule.
